Welcome to Vasilias Recruiter! 🤝

Our group is created to share Singapore job vacancies, overseas employment opportunities, recruitment updates, and work pass information for people looking to build their careers in Singapore.

🎯 **OUR MAIN OBJECTIVE**

To help job seekers discover employment opportunities in Singapore by sharing relevant job information, vacancy updates, and recruitment announcements.

💼 **JOB CATEGORIES**

🔹 Factory & Manufacturing Jobs  
🔹 Construction & General Worker Jobs  
🔹 Hotel & Hospitality Jobs  
🔹 Cleaning & Housekeeping Jobs  
🔹 Warehouse & Packing Jobs  
🔹 Driver & Delivery Jobs  
🔹 Technician & Maintenance Jobs  
🔹 Restaurant & Kitchen Jobs  
🔹 Skilled & Professional Jobs  
🔹 Other Singapore Employment Opportunities  

📢 **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT**

✅ Singapore job vacancy updates  
✅ Recruitment announcements  
✅ Job role and eligibility information  
✅ Work pass and application process information  
✅ Employer and interview updates, when available  
✅ Important overseas employment guidance  

💳 **OUR MOTTO: VISA FIRST, PAYMENT NEXT.**

We believe in transparency, responsible recruitment, and clear communication. Always confirm the employer, written job offer, recruitment terms, and applicable work pass requirements before making any payment. Visa or work pass approval is subject to the relevant Singapore authorities.

📌 **GROUP RULES**

1️⃣ Share only relevant and genuine job-related information.  
2️⃣ Do not post spam, misleading advertisements, or unrelated promotions.  
3️⃣ Never share passport details, banking information, OTPs, or other sensitive personal information publicly.  
4️⃣ Verify job offers, employer details, salary, accommodation, and other employment conditions independently.  
5️⃣ Do not make payments based solely on messages or promises posted in this group.  
6️⃣ Respect all members and maintain a professional environment.  
7️⃣ Job availability, eligibility, salary, and selection depend on the employer and the applicable requirements.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER**

Vasilias Recruiter shares job-related information for awareness and guidance. Group membership does not guarantee employment, an interview, a visa, or work pass approval. Always verify information through appropriate official channels before making decisions.

🌟 **YOUR CAREER JOURNEY STARTS WITH THE RIGHT INFORMATION!**

Join Vasilias Recruiter to stay informed about Singapore job opportunities and overseas career updates.

🇸🇬 **VASILIAS RECRUITER**  
*Your Gateway to Overseas Career Opportunities.* 🌍

hkdm87uodp5d8spovgm0tn.description:
GcodeX DIGITAL SKILLS & OPPORTUNITIES

Learn. Apply. Grow.

GcodeX Digital Skills & Opportunities is a digital education and opportunities community focused on helping students, beginners, creators, freelancers, and aspiring entrepreneurs develop practical digital skills and better understand the modern online economy.

We provide accessible educational resources, practical guidance, digital tools, and information about online opportunities that can help individuals build knowledge, develop valuable skills, and create meaningful digital value.

WHAT WE DO

GcodeX focuses on practical areas of digital development, including:

Digital Skills & Technology
Beginner-friendly education covering useful digital tools, platforms, technologies, and skills relevant to today's digital environment.

Artificial Intelligence
Educational resources and practical guidance on understanding and using AI tools for learning, productivity, content creation, and digital work.

Affiliate Marketing
Training and educational resources covering affiliate marketing fundamentals, content strategies, audience development, product research, and ethical promotion.

Online Business
Practical information for people interested in developing digital businesses, services, products, and other online ventures.

Digital Tools & Resources
Carefully selected resources, platforms, and tools that can help members learn, create, work, and operate more effectively online.

Online Opportunities
Information about digital opportunities, platforms, programs, and business models that members can independently research and evaluate.

OUR MISSION

Our mission is to make practical digital education more accessible to beginners while encouraging a responsible and realistic approach to building online skills and opportunities.

We believe sustainable digital growth comes from knowledge, practical experience, consistency, critical thinking, and continuous improvement.

OUR APPROACH

Learn. Apply. Grow.

We don't promote unrealistic expectations about making money online.

There are no promises of guaranteed income, instant success, or effortless wealth.

Instead, GcodeX focuses on:

- Developing practical skills
- Understanding how digital platforms work
- Learning through application
- Evaluating opportunities carefully
- Building useful knowledge
- Improving through experience
- Creating genuine digital value

Results will naturally differ between individuals depending on their skills, effort, experience, market conditions, and other factors.

A COMMUNITY FOR LEARNING

GcodeX is designed to be more than a place where information is simply shared.

Members are encouraged to learn, ask questions, exchange useful knowledge, explore digital tools, discuss strategies, and apply what they discover.

Whether you are completely new to the digital space or already developing your online skills, the community is designed to provide useful information that can support your learning journey.

RESPONSIBLE OPPORTUNITY DISCOVERY

The online world contains many genuine opportunities, but it also contains misleading claims, scams, poor-quality products, and unrealistic promises.

GcodeX therefore encourages members to research before committing.

Before spending money, joining a platform, or participating in an opportunity, members should understand what they are getting into, review the relevant terms, consider the risks, and make their own informed decisions.

TRANSPARENCY

Some resources or products discussed through GcodeX may involve affiliate partnerships.

Where applicable, affiliate relationships should be disclosed clearly. An affiliate relationship does not mean that a particular product or opportunity is suitable for everyone.

Members are encouraged to conduct their own research and make decisions based on their individual circumstances.

WHO IS GcodeX FOR?

GcodeX is built for:

- Students interested in digital skills
- Beginners entering the online space
- Aspiring entrepreneurs
- Content creators
- Freelancers and digital workers
- People learning about AI
- Individuals exploring affiliate marketing
- People interested in online business
- Anyone seeking practical digital education and useful resources

No advanced experience is required.

The community is designed to help people start where they are, learn progressively, and improve through practical application.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES

Education over hype.

Skills over shortcuts.

Research over assumptions.

Value over empty promises.

Progress over perfection.

JOIN GcodeX

If you are interested in developing practical digital skills, understanding online opportunities, learning about modern digital tools, and becoming more informed about the digital economy, GcodeX Digital Skills & Opportunities provides a community built around learning, practical application, and responsible growth.

GcodeX DIGITAL SKILLS & OPPORTUNITIES

Learn. Apply. Grow.

gdgjn0rxniv6k4lfhpofsu.description:
अस्सलामु अलैकुम व रहमतुल्लाहि व बरकातुह

All India Muslim Youth Education Network (AIMYEN) में आपका ख़ैर-मक़दम है।

AIMYEN एक ग़ैर-सियासी (Non-Political) और तालीम-पर-मबनी क़ौमी नेटवर्क है, जिसका मक़सद भारत के मुस्लिम नौजवानों को तालीम, इल्म, हुनर और बेहतर मुस्तक़बिल के लिए एक मज़बूत प्लेटफ़ॉर्म फ़राहम करना है।

इस नेटवर्क के ज़रिए आपको मिलेगी: 

• स्कूल व हायर एजुकेशन अपडेट्स 
• स्कॉलरशिप की जानकारी 
• कॉलेज एडमिशन गाइडेंस 
• प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की तैयारी 
• सरकारी व प्राइवेट जॉब अपडेट्स 
• करियर काउंसलिंग व मेंटरशिप 
• स्किल डेवलपमेंट व डिजिटल लर्निंग 
• स्टार्टअप व एंटरप्रेन्योरशिप गाइडेंस 
• मोटिवेशनल व एजुकेशनल कंटेंट 
• देशभर के स्टूडेंट्स, टीचर्स, प्रोफेशनल्स और वॉलंटियर्स से नेटवर्किंग

हमारा मक़सद हर राज्य, ज़िला, तहसील, शहर और गाँव तक तालीम की रोशनी पहुँचाना और मुस्लिम नौजवानों को इल्म, अख़लाक़, क़ियादत और ख़िदमत-ए-ख़ल्क़ के जज़्बे के साथ आगे बढ़ाना है।

Mission:

Educate • Empower • Connect Every Muslim Youth of India

Vision:
भारत का सबसे बड़ा मुस्लिम एजुकेशन नेटवर्क तैयार करना, जो हर युवा को सीखने, आगे बढ़ने और समाज व मुल्क की तरक़्क़ी में अपना किरदार अदा करने का मौक़ा दे।

"इल्म से तरक़्क़ी • इत्तेहाद से ताक़त • तालीम सबके लिए"

AIMYEN – Together We Learn, Together We Grow, Together We Lead.

What is RemoteOPS?
RemoteOPS is a remote work community for people who want to earn from gaming-related tasks. You do not need to be an expert gamer or a streamer. If you have a laptop or PC, a stable internet connection, and can follow simple instructions, you can take part.
How it works:
1. Join through the invite link. Every request is approved by an admin, so the group stays clean and spam-free.

2. A task is posted in the announcements section. Tasks are usually game tutorials, in-game challenges, or short testing activities.

3. You claim a task in the chat, complete it, and send a screenshot or short video as proof.

4. Payment is sent within 24 to 48 hours via PayPal, or in crypto if you prefer.
Why members stay:
- New tasks are posted regularly, so there is always something to do.
- Payments are made after every completed task, not once a month.
- Clear rules: proof for every task, fair queuing, and repeated no-shows lead to removal, which keeps the group professional.
- Top performers get first access to larger tasks.
Who fits this group:
Students, part-time job seekers, gamers, and anyone looking for a simple side income. Members from any country are welcome. All you need is a laptop, an internet connection, and a PayPal account or a crypto wallet.
Joining is free. Full details of each task are shared inside the group only, so everything stays organized in one place.
